text:
maria: Quick sync — Aperture Systems just asked for a joint perf/W + kernel calibration run next Tue. They want throughput, watt, and kernel-tune notes for a co-published appendix. Who can own the instrumentation and run templates?

ethan: I can take telemetry and the runner scripts. Do we have standard PDU sampling rates and an agreed S3 path? :thinking_face:

simon: Aperture said they'll bring PDUs with watt/sec readings and NVML logs. We need to confirm clock sync and sampling alignment (nvml vs pdu). Also confirm CUDA/runtime versions.

nora: Proposal for workloads: steady-state inference (8k context) with 3 phases: batch=1, batch=8, batch=32. Each phase 45m steady-state plus 15m ramp. Collect 95/99 latency, p90 power, sustained throughput (tokens/s), and perf/W (tokens/s per watt).

maria: good. Also include a short tail-latency micro-benchmark (burst of 500 short inferences) to test KV-cache behavior.

ethan: I'll add the run command template. Example:
```
./run_bench --model=gpt-j-6b --seq=8192 --batch=8 --duration=3600 \
  --nvml-sample=1s --pdu-sample=2s --trace-kvcache --out-prefix=aperture-run
```
simon: add commands to capture kernel/build info: `uname -a`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv` and `cat /proc/modules | grep nv` so we can reproduce kernel-level diffs.

nora: Naming convention for artifacts: `aperture-<date>-<region>-<gpu>-<batch>.json` and single S3 bucket `s3://redwood-partner-bench/aperture/`. We should also publish raw telemetry + sanitized summary CSVs.

maria: On rollout: let's run a canary on our dev pool Fri to validate the runner and metric collectors. Then Wed partner run in their lab, Thurs internal re-run for parity. Does that schedule work?

ethan: Fri canary works for me. I'll push runner to `bench/interop/aperture` and tag release `v0.3-aperture` by EOD Thu. :white_check_mark:

simon: I'll coordinate with Aperture infra contact (cc: their ops lead) to confirm rack mapping and power feed naming. Also request their kernel patch list if they've tuned drivers.

maria: One more item — Aperture asked for an embargoed joint writeup; they prefer embargo until June 1. We should treat data as confidential until then and put ACLs on the S3 path. Nora, can you handle permissions + a short NDA note?

nora: Yep — will add bucket ACL + shared group `aperture-benchers`, and draft a 1-paragraph embargo note for legal to sign off.

bench-bot: created bench template `aperture-interop-v0.3` and assigned `ethan` as owner.

maria: Action items: (1) ethan -> telemetry runner + canary, (2) simon -> partner infra sync, (3) nora -> S3 ACL + embargo note. We'll reconvene Mon 11am PT to review canary logs. If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :calendar:

ethan: 👍 I'll post the run link and preliminary collector logs after the Fri canary.

simon: will ping Aperture for kernel patch list now.

nora: will set ACLs and post the embargo draft by EOD Thu.

maria: Thanks all — this is short but clear. If we hit any noise in telemetry, prefer single change at a time (kernel vs quant) so we can attribute impact. :mag:
